Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Changelog:
- Reworked player keep rules into protected players and priority players. Targets, party/alliance members, and friends can now stay visible outside the visible player budget.
- Added drag-and-drop ordering for priority keep rules, so limited visible slots are assigned by user-defined rule order instead of object table order.
- Redesigned the culling settings UI with compact status, budget, keep-rule, pause-condition, and attached-object sections.
- Removed the nearby range live preview and the ffxiv_pictomancy dependency.
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
